title: R-305 時間窗寫法還原為 BETWEEN
description: 為與其他規則寫法一致,時間窗改回 BETWEEN。閾值未動。

files.diff:
@@ -10 +10 @@
-  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
+  AND t.tx_time BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
files.full_content:
-- R-305: 夜間跨行轉帳大額異常(超過 200000 通報)
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND t.is_interbank = TRUE
  AND t.currency = 'TWD'
  AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.tx_time) < 6
  AND t.tx_time BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 200000;

_golden.intent: 時間窗閉區間錯誤:specs/R-305.md 需求項目 5 明訂半開區間,BETWEEN 會把 end_date 當日 00:00:00 的交易重複計入相鄰批次 → 應被指出,不得自動放行。閾值本身正確,只有區間錯。
